summary: Frontend-only testing of Dashboard v2 (Velocely ERP). Login admin/Admin123! ok. Verified greeting, quick actions, attention center, recent activity, quick analysis chart and all existing KPI/charts render. All 4 quick actions navigate correctly and both create actions (Orçamento/Encomenda) produced records that were deleted afterwards. Attention cards and recent activity links all navigate to the correct destinations. No page errors, no uncaught runtime errors on the Dashboard.

issues: Hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in OrcamentoPanels.jsx line 19 (consumíveis select). Not a Dashboard issue but visible when navigating from qa-novo-orcamento.

action_items: (Optional) Fix hydration warning in OrcamentoPanels: remove wrapper <span> inside <option> for consumíveis dropdown to eliminate console warning on orçamento detail page (unrelated to Dashboard but surfaced during navigation from qa-novo-orcamento).
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx & widgets.jsx look clean, RBAC gating via can()/isAdmin is applied consistently to KPIs and charts.
QuickActions.novoOrcamento/novaEncomenda have no try/catch — a failing POST (network/permission) would throw an unhandled promise rejection in production. Consider try/catch + toast.error.
AttCard testid uses label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-') — works but is fragile if labels change; consider stable testids (e.g., att-encomendas-autorizar).
QuickAnalysis has no dedicated data-testid (only the Card wrapper) — consider adding data-testid='dash-quick-analysis' for future testing.
eventos in RecentActivity uses api.get('/historico?limit=8') — good; empty state and loading state both handled.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 orçamento (id 5d313fc2-81f4-46dc-96d6-1c16de367093) and 1 encomenda (id b109213c-e87d-46bb-bf51-eab32cd5a269) via quick actions. Both DELETED successfully via DELETE /api/orcamentos/{id} and /api/encomendas/{id} with Bearer token (final GET returns 404). No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth uses Bearer token stored in localStorage under key 'prodcost_token'. For cleanup, always use: const t=localStorage.getItem('prodcost_token'); fetch(url,{method:'DELETE',headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+t}}). credentials:'include' alone will NOT work — backend requires Authorization header. Login field is 'utilizador' (text input, not email) — first text input in the form. Server date is currently July 2026 (2026-07-15).
verified_flows: dash-greeting shows 'Boa noite, Admin' + full date (Portuguese)
dash-quick-actions renders 4 buttons (qa-novo-orcamento, qa-nova-encomenda, qa-novo-cliente, qa-ver-ofs)
dash-attention renders 5 active cards (att-* prefixed). First card 'Encomendas por autorizar' navigates to /encomendas OK
Análise rápida · financeiro bar chart renders with 5 bars (Faturado/Recebido/Pendente/Custo real/Margem) no errors
dash-recent-activity shows 8 events with utilizador + relative time; 7 have links; first activity link navigates to entity detail OK
All existing KPIs and charts (Stat cards, PrazosBanner, EncValorCustoChart, PagamentoPie, MensalArea, OFEstadoChart, TempoChart, TempoCustoTotais, TopArtigosChart) render for admin without errors
No page errors / uncaught runtime errors on Dashboard; 0 pageerror events
